backend: codex CLI 0.159 built-in image generation (`codex exec -i <style ref> -`), 1 image per call, raw 1254x1254 icons / 1024x1536 portraits

icons.prompt: A single dark-fantasy action-RPG skill icon, original design. A circular medallion of dark cracked charcoal stone with a thin, narrow, worn dark-iron rim (rim width only about 3 percent of the diameter, a slim chipped band, not chunky stone blocks), viewed straight on, perfectly centred, the circle filling about 86 percent of the square canvas. Inside the medallion: <subject> Bold simple silhouette, large subject filling most of the medallion, strong saturated magical glow, high contrast against the dark stone, clearly readable when shrunk to 64 pixels. Painterly hand-painted game-icon rendering, grim and moody. Everything outside the medallion is a completely flat, uniform, pure magenta (#FF00FF) background with no shadow, no glow, no gradient and no texture. No text, no letters, no numbers, no writing, no watermark, no extra frame or border beyond the stone medallion.
icons.post_process: tools/ui/build_class_skill_atlas.py import <raw> <name>  (chroma-key bbox -> 206 px disc centred in 256, circular mask, level 7%,100%,0.92)

subjects.warden_q_b: a heavily armoured knight seen as a dark compact silhouette crashing down from a leap, greatsword driven point-first into the ground at the centre, the stone floor splitting into wide radiating cracks that glow molten amber, chunks of rock thrown upward. Deep amber-orange is the one dominant hue.
subjects.warden_e_b: a battered, dented round steel shield with a central boss, seen from the front, large in the centre, with one bright golden shockwave ring bursting outward around it and a few short golden rays. Pale yellow-gold light and grey steel; yellow-gold is the one dominant hue.
subjects.warden_r_b: one large crescent-shaped blade of energy, like a slash made solid, flying from lower-left to upper-right and cutting a glowing groove through the stone, white-hot at its leading edge fading to vivid orange-red at its tail, with a few sparks. A simple big crescent shape; hot orange is the one dominant hue.
subjects.stalker_basic: one single arrow in flight, pointing up and to the right along the diagonal, with a shaft carved from pale ivory bone, a sharp barbed bone arrowhead and tattered grey fletching, trailing a thin streak of teal spectral light and a few bone splinters. Teal is the one dominant hue.
subjects.stalker_q_a: very simple composition with only three elements: one hooded hunter as a solid dark silhouette, upside-down at the top of a backward flip with body arched, large and clear in the upper-right; three bright glowing pale mint-white arrows flying out in a tight fan toward the lower-left, each with a straight light trail; and one thin crescent arc of pale light tracing the flip. No swirling smoke, no clutter. Pale mint-white is the one dominant hue.
subjects.stalker_q_b: one large curved dagger carved from pale bone with a wrapped leather grip, thrusting diagonally from the lower-left to the upper-right, bursting out of thick billowing dark smoke, with wisps of deep violet shadow streaming behind the blade. Dusky violet is the one dominant hue.
subjects.stalker_e_a: five or six pale bone arrows falling steeply from the top of the icon down onto a glowing circular target ring marked on the ground, seen at an angle in the lower half of the icon, some arrows already stuck in the ground inside the ring. The ring and falling streaks glow cold steel-blue. Cold steel-blue is the one dominant hue.
subjects.stalker_e_b: exactly seven pale ivory bone arrows spreading out in a wide symmetrical fan from a single point at the bottom centre, arrowheads pointing upward and outward like the ribs of an open hand fan, each with a short warm trail. Warm ivory and pale parchment-gold; ivory is the one dominant hue.
subjects.stalker_r_a: one large, thick, heavy arrow with a broad barbed head, blazing bright emerald-green, flying horizontally from left to right across the whole width of the medallion, bold and unmistakable; it pierces through the chests of two dark ghostly humanoid figures (clear head-and-shoulders shapes with hollow eyes) standing in a row, with a small ring-shaped green shock burst where it passes through each. The arrow is the biggest and brightest element. Bright emerald-green is the one dominant hue.
subjects.stalker_r_b: a bone arrow striking point-first at the centre, its head a cracked glowing ember charge that is exploding on impact into a round burst of fire, sparks and stone shards, the bone shaft still visible entering from the lower-left. Fiery ember orange is the one dominant hue.
subjects.embercaller_basic: one small burning ember orb at the centre, a jagged faceted shard-like coal with a white-hot core, wrapped in licking orange flame with a short trailing tail of sparks and ash to the lower-left, as if hurled forward. Glowing ember orange is the one dominant hue.
subjects.embercaller_q_a: very simple composition with only three elements: on the left a hooded robed figure crumbling apart into drifting ash flakes; on the right the same hooded robed figure whole and solid, a clear dark silhouette with a bright violet rim light; and one single curved stream of glowing violet ash arcing over between them. Bold, uncluttered, big shapes. Violet is the one dominant hue.
subjects.embercaller_q_b: a small robed figure standing at the centre bottom, raising a staff, enclosed by a large translucent protective dome made of swirling ash and glowing embers, the dome clearly a half-sphere shape with a bright rim. Warm amber-gold light; amber-gold is the one dominant hue.
subjects.embercaller_e_a: a large ring of jagged ice spikes erupting outward from the centre in all directions, seen from above at a slight angle, like a crown of frost shards expanding across the stone, with a dark empty centre and frozen mist. Pale icy cyan-white is the one dominant hue.
subjects.embercaller_e_b: exactly five long tongues of flame sweeping outward in a wide fan from a single point at the bottom centre, each a separate curling streak of fire spreading upward and outward. Bright yellow-orange fire; yellow-orange is the one dominant hue.
subjects.embercaller_r_a: one large burning meteor, a dark rock wreathed in fire with a long smoky tail, plunging diagonally from the upper-right down toward a glowing circular arcane sigil of simple concentric rings drawn on the ground at the lower-left. Deep crimson-red fire and glow; crimson is the one dominant hue.
subjects.embercaller_r_b: one long, thick spear pointing diagonally from lower-left to upper-right across the whole medallion, its broad leaf-shaped head and shaft formed of pale grey compacted ash, with a bright glowing ember-orange core line running along the centre of the shaft into the head; a tight bright indigo-blue aura hugs the spear and a few straight blue speed streaks trail behind it. The spear is thick, bright, bold and unmistakable; no rings or circles. Indigo-blue is the one dominant hue.

portraits.prompt: A painterly dark-fantasy character portrait card for a class-select screen, original character design. <character> The figure stands facing the viewer in a slight three-quarter turn, framed from the knees up, centred, head in the upper third with clear space above it, the whole silhouette and weapon inside the frame. Background: the dim interior of a ruined gothic reliquary cathedral, almost lost in darkness and drifting ash, only hinted at. Dramatic low-key lighting, strong rim light on the figure, rich painterly brushwork, grim and solemn mood. Heavy dark vignette: all four edges and corners fade smoothly to near-black so the card can sit on a near-black panel. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no border, no frame, no UI elements.
portraits.post_process: magick crop (2:3 window of the raw, see crop) -> resize 512x768 -> multiply by blurred rounded-rect vignette (roundrectangle 24,24 487,743 r70, blur 0x26, level 0%,88%) -> PNG24

warden.description: An armoured reliquary knight: battered dark steel plate armour with tarnished gold reliquary engravings, a closed great helm with a tall crest, a tattered dark-red cloak over one shoulder, both gauntleted hands resting on the pommel of a long straight sword held point-down in front of him. Warm ember-orange light glows from below and from drifting sparks; dark red and tarnished gold accents.

stalker.description: A lean hooded hunter: fitted ash-grey leather armour with a harness of pale carved bone plates across the chest and one shoulder, a deep hood shadowing the eyes, a long scarf and hood lining in clearly visible muted teal, a tall recurve bow made of pale bone and dark sinew held upright at the side in the left hand with a taut, correctly strung bowstring running straight from tip to tip and faintly glowing teal, a quiver of bone-shafted teal-fletched arrows at the hip, the right hand resting on an arrow in the quiver. Cold pale moonlight as key light from the upper left so the figure, bone plates and bow read clearly against the dark; teal is the accent colour of this card.

embercaller.description: A tall, gaunt robed ash-priest: long layered robes in clearly saturated deep violet-blue dusted with grey ash, a high pointed cowl framing a pale stern face, a thin metal circlet on the brow, one hand gripping a tall charred black wooden staff topped with an iron cage holding a large brightly glowing ember-orange crystal, the other hand open with embers floating above the palm. The ember crystal is the key light: warm orange light on the face, hands and upper robes, against cool violet-blue cloth and shadow; violet-blue is the accent colour of this card. Ash flakes drifting.
